column1: # libreoffice build 420(Build:2) on linux — document, line, drift below the page (pt), drift right of the page (pt), wider than the page (pt), letters

# rows of invoice-consulting and invoice-consulting_long: from CI run 42480884766, when a table's rows came to carry what each is written taller than the page by and settle it in their bottom margins, the item rows set level where each had stood a fiftieth of a point lower than the one above

# rows of cv-classic_serif, cv-timeline_minimal, cv-violet_grid, letter-timeline_minimal and rota-cobalt: from CI run 42843379275, when centred and right-aligned text Word sets at a rounded size came to be spaced over several lines, beside a picture and in a header or footer slot; ClassicSerif's profile lines stand as wide as the page, their centres where they stood, 18pt right with their panel

# every other row from CI run 41696246504, shot whole when the gate came to hold each line to its width, which the column before the letters records: no line moved more than half a point down or across from the row it replaces, none was lost and none found anew, and every document's row reads as it did
